extraction_notes: Only Figure 1 in the main text contains measured catalytic performance quantities requested here (methanol STY, CO2 conversion and methanol selectivity). Figures 4 and 6 are adsorption/mechanistic characterisation rather than catalytic performance; Figure 6b,c time traces are DRIFTS intermediate intensities, not product performance, and Figure 6d is TPSR signal intensity, so they were skipped. Extended Data figures were not digitised because the request was limited to main-text figures. The two zero-content points at x = 0 in Figure 1b were not assigned because they correspond to support-only endpoints rather than named catalyst entries in the legend/user catalyst list.
